integrity: The mathematical statement is supported by an explicit all-face integer-lattice enumeration and algebraic face/Segre arguments. Finite graded checks support, but do not prove, the full Hilbert series. Self-review only; no independent verification or audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete reduced singular locus and homogeneous coordinate Hilbert series for the five-leaf normal binary-network toric variety; not the nonreduced Jacobian singular scheme, nongeneric local analytic type, conductor, or larger trees. Characteristic-two claim is the integral toric network model; Fourier-to-stochastic CFN equivalence requires characteristic different from two. Possible implicit prior coverage in general toric face-ring theory remains an originality risk.
title: Four Segre singular components of the five-leaf binary phylogenetic toric variety
